feeds.title: Cooking with Yoshiko » Vegan
feeds.description: Cooking with Yoshiko is all about eating for a better lifestyle and the benefits of creating easy and nutritious meals for your overall well-being. Keep up to date with Yoshiko's latest posts about Japanese Superfoods and the important role they have in leading your health and beauty. Find some delicious vegan recipes on her vegan blog site.

feeds.title: Chef JA Cooks Blog
feeds.description: Hi, it's JURI (aka Chef JA)! I'm not a vegan, but I do not eat meat and like a plant-based diet, so you can find a lot of vegan/vegetarian recipes in my blog. Find Simple and Easy Japanese Plant-Based Recipes in my blogs that are healthy, tasty, easy family-friendly meals including vegetarian and vegan.

feeds.title: Veganuary » Japanese Vegan Recipes
feeds.description: Veganuary is a non-profit organization that encourages people worldwide to try vegan for January and beyond. Japanese cuisine is popular the world over and you can still enjoy these classic dishes on a plant-based diet! We have plenty of vegan Japanese recipes for you to tuck into. Read our vegan Japanese recipes.

feeds.title: Okonomi Kitchen
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Lisa. Welcome to Okonomi Kitchen! Here you'll find delicious vegan recipes that are healthy, simple & easy to make. Also a bit of everything, but mostly feel-good recipes inspired by whole foods- mostly plant-based and usually gluten, oil & refined sugar-free. You'll probably find a lot of recipes from Japanese cuisine and other cuisines around the world.

feeds.title: BentoYa Cooking Blog
feeds.description: BentoYa Cooking is all about reimagining traditional Japanese dishes in a way anyone can enjoy them, regardless of their dietary preferences. The official BentoYa blog has no shortage of yummy recipes, vegan news, and musings on healthy eating penned by the BentoYa Volunteer Family. Find recent updates, exciting news, and new plant-based recipes!

feeds.title: Vegan Bunny Chef
feeds.description: Hey there! Welcome to my vegan foodie world! I'm Elle, the recipe developer, and photographer behind this blog. Here you'll find many vegan delicious recipes that use only real food, no highly processed or hard-to-seek stuff!

feeds.title: Herbivores Kitchen » Japanese Vegan Recipes
feeds.description: My name is Kate and I am the food blogger behind all of the vegan recipes that you'll find on Herbivore's Kitchen! Here you'll find helpful and informative food blogging articles and plenty of tips and tricks. Check out my vegan Japanese recipes! Explore vegan sushi ideas and how to make every dish sing with miso paste, and many more.

feeds.title: Japan Vegan Guide Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I am Jesse. I started this blog a decade ago as a 'sister blog' to my main blog about vegan life in Taiwan. I wanted to provide some basic starting information for vegans traveling to or living in Japan. This blog page is an up-to-date guide to vegan food and restaurants in Japan for English-speaking travelers.

feeds.title: Plant-Based Matters
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Akiko, the creator of Plant-Based Matters where you find authentic & unique Japanese vegan recipes and Japanese fusion recipes! I'm the recipe developer & food stylist, in other words, the brains of Plant-Based Matters which is co-operated with my husband, Peter, the photographer. Find all the best authentic vegan Japanese food recipes on our blog and Japanese fusion vegan recipes.
